blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Machine unlearning aims to remove targeted information from large language models, but existing evaluations often measure forgetting only on a designated benchmark distribution. We argue that such behavioral forgetting is an insufficient standard for privacy-oriented unlearning, and that evaluation should instead test whether forgetting persists across the access paths through which the same information may be recovered. We demonstrate this with a controlled case study of cross-lingual querying: across multiple multilingual model families, forgetting varies substantially when semantically equivalent information is queried in different languages and scripts. A single access path is therefore enough to expose a real gap between behavioral forgetting and information inaccessibility, motivating broader evaluation of access-path generalization and adversarial recoverability alongside in-distribution forgetting.
blocks.zh: 机器不学习的目的是从大型语文模式中去除有针对性的信息,但现有的评价往往只衡量在指定基准分配上被遗忘的情况。 我们主张,这种忘记行为不足以成为注重隐私的不学习的标准,而评价应检验在可能检索相同信息的进入途径上是否仍然存在忘记。 我们用对跨语言查询的可控案例研究来证明这一点:在多种多语言示范家庭,当以不同语言和脚本查询内容相当的信息时,忘记差异很大。 因此,单一的准入途径足以揭示行为遗忘与信息无法获得之间的真正差距,促使更广泛地评价准入途径的通俗化和对抗性可恢复性,同时避免传播。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly internalize personal information, copyrighted content, proprietary data, and other sensitive knowledge, motivating interest in machine unlearning : the selective removal of targeted information from a deployed model. Unlike retraining from scratch, practical unlearning methods attempt to remove this information while preserving the model’s broader capabilities. However, a central challenge remains: determining whether targeted information has actually been removed. Existing evaluations rely primarily on behavioral probes, benchmark performance, or statistical tests, which can demonstrate changes in model behavior but cannot establish that forgotten information is unrecoverable ( Jagielski et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型越来越将个人信息、版权内容、专有数据和其他敏感知识内部化,激发了对机器不学习的兴趣:有选择地从部署的模型中删除目标信息。 与从零开始的再培训不同,实用的不学习方法试图去除这些信息,同时保留模型更广泛的能力. 然而,一个中心挑战依然存在:确定是否确实删除了有针对性的信息。 现有评价主要依靠行为探针,基准性能,或统计测试,这些测试可以显示模型行为的变化,但不能确定被遗忘的信息是无法恢复的(Jagielski等,2023年).

blocks.en: This distinction is particularly important for privacy. Successful forgetting under a designated evaluation distribution does not necessarily imply that the underlying information is inaccessible through other queries or representations. We therefore distinguish behavioral forgetting , whether a model appears to forget under a specified evaluation distribution, from the stronger privacy objective of information inaccessibility , which we treat as non-recoverability under a specified family of access mechanisms or threat model. Empirical evaluation cannot certify the latter, but it can provide stronger evidence by testing whether forgetting remains robust across alternative ways of accessing the same information.
blocks.zh: 这种区分对隐私尤其重要。 根据指定的评价分布,成功遗忘并不一定意味着通过其他查询或陈述无法获取基本信息。 因此,我们将行为忘却(一个模型是否在指定的评价分布下似乎忘记)与信息无法获得的更强隐私目标区分开来,我们视后者为特定家庭获取机制或威胁模式下的不可恢复性。 经验评价不能证明后者,但可以通过测试不同方式获取相同信息的忘却是否仍然有力,从而提供更有力的证据。

blocks.en: Multilingual LLMs provide a natural setting for exposing this gap. Semantically equivalent information can be queried across different languages and scripts while the underlying information remains approximately fixed. If information appears forgotten in one language but remains recoverable in another, then a monolingual evaluation can overstate the strength of forgetting. We refer to these alternative mechanisms for querying or recovering the same information as access paths . Cross-lingual querying is one such access path: it changes the surface form through which targeted information is queried while approximately preserving the underlying information itself, and multilingual factual associations provide a controlled setting in which this can be tested directly. A single access path is enough to test our position; we use cross-lingual unlearning as that case study and take up broader access paths in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 多语种LLMS为揭露这一差距提供了一个自然环境。 在基本信息大致固定的情况下,不同语言和脚本可以查询语义等同的信息。 如果信息似乎以一种语言被遗忘,但在另一种语言中仍然可以恢复,那么,单一语言的评价可以夸大遗忘的力量。 我们参考这些查询或恢复与访问路径相同信息的替代机制。 交叉语言查询是这种访问途径之一:它改变对目标信息进行查询的表面形式,同时大致保留基本信息本身,多语种事实关联提供了一个可直接测试的可控环境。 单一的进入路径足以测试我们的立场;我们使用跨语言的不学习作为案例研究,并在第4节中采用更广泛的进入路径。

blocks.en: Our position is that behavioral forgetting under a fixed evaluation distribution is insufficient evidence for privacy-oriented unlearning. We advance this position in three ways. First, we distinguish behavioral forgetting from the stronger objective of information inaccessibility and introduce access-path evaluation as a principle for testing whether forgetting persists beyond the original evaluation distribution. Second, we demonstrate this directly with cross-lingual querying: using results from cTOFU, we show that conclusions about unlearning success can change within this single, controlled access path. Third, we argue that this is sufficient evidence to motivate broader future work in which privacy-oriented benchmarks progress from in-distribution forgetting to access-path generalization and adversarial recoverability.
blocks.zh: 我们的立场是,在固定的评价分配中忘记行为不足以证明注重隐私的不学习。 我们以三种方式推进这一立场。 首先,我们将行为遗忘与信息无法获得的更强目标区分开来,并将接入路径评价作为检验是否超越原评价分配的遗忘持续存在的原则。 第二,我们用跨语言的查询直接证明这一点:我们利用cTOFU的结果,表明关于不学习成功的结论可以在这个单一的,有控制的准入路径中改变. 第三,我们争辩说,这足以激励今后开展更广泛的工作,在这项工作中,注重隐私的基准从分配中逐渐扩大,而忽略了通路通俗化和可收回性。

blocks.en: A reasonable alternative is that fixed-distribution evaluation is a practical and sufficient standard when broader testing is costly. We argue this supports only a narrower claim: success on a designated benchmark, not evidence that information is broadly inaccessible. A single access path where forgetting fails to generalize is already enough to show fixed-distribution evaluation cannot be treated as a privacy guarantee.
blocks.zh: 一个合理的替代办法是,当更广泛的测试费用高昂时,固定分配评价是一种实用而充分的标准。 我们认为,这只支持一种较狭隘的说法:在指定基准上取得成功,而不是证明信息广泛无法获取。 忘记无法概括的单一访问路径已经足以显示固定分配评价,不能被视为隐私保障。

blocks.en: 2 From Behavioral Forgetting to Privacy-Oriented Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2 从行为忘却到面向隐私的评价

blocks.en: 2.1 Current Unlearning Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.1 当前 " 学习 " 评价

blocks.en: LLM unlearning benchmarks typically evaluate forgetting on a designated forget set while measuring preservation of unrelated knowledge or broader model capabilities. Representative benchmarks include TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , WMDP ( Li et al., 2024 ) , and RWKU ( Jin et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 长期法学硕士不学习基准通常在衡量相关知识的保存或更广泛的模型能力的同时,评价在指定一套忘却中遗忘的情况。 代表性基准包括TOFU(Maini等,2024年),MASP(Li等,2024年)和RWKU(Jin等,2024年)。

blocks.en: TOFU exemplifies this paradigm, evaluating whether an unlearned model resembles a retain-only reference model on synthetic factual associations via a Truth Ratio and KS-test criterion ( p > 0.1 p>0.1 ) ( Maini et al., 2024 ) . Model utility is measured using the harmonic mean of nine capability metrics, with results reported relative to the corresponding base model.
blocks.zh: TOFU说明了这一范式,通过真理比和KS测试标准(p > 0.1 p>0.1),评价未学习模型是否类似于关于合成事实关联的仅保留参考模型。 (Maini等,2024). 模型效用用9个能力度量的口琴平均值来测量,结果与相应的基准模型相对相报.

blocks.en: 2.2 The Evaluation Gap
blocks.zh: 2.2 评价差距

blocks.en: These metrics establish behavioral forgetting under a predefined evaluation distribution, but provide limited evidence about whether the same information remains accessible elsewhere. This concern arises across languages ( Lu and Koehn, 2025 ) , modalities ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , and adversarial interactions designed to recover residual information ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Thus, satisfying a benchmark forgetting criterion should not by itself be interpreted as evidence that targeted information is inaccessible.
blocks.zh: 这些衡量标准确定在预先确定的评价分布下的行为遗忘,但对于同一信息是否仍可在别处获取,提供的证据有限. 这种关切在各种语言(Lu和Koehn,2025年),模式(Patil等,2025年;Chen等,2025年),以及旨在取回剩余信息的对抗性互动(Patil等,2025年;Zhang等,2025年)。 因此,满足一个忘记标准的基准本身不应被解释为无法获取目标信息的证据。

blocks.en: For privacy-oriented evaluation, we therefore treat information inaccessibility as a stronger objective and ask how much empirical evidence can be obtained that forgetting persists beyond the original evaluation distribution. Rather than claiming to establish inaccessibility, this shifts evaluation toward testing the robustness of forgetting across alternative mechanisms for accessing the same targeted information.
blocks.zh: 因此,关于面向隐私的评价,我们把获取信息不便视为一个更强有力的目标,并询问可以获取多少经验证据,说明在最初的评价分配之外,遗忘仍然存在。 这一评价并非声称无法获取,而是转向测试在获取相同目标信息的各种替代机制中遗忘的力度。

blocks.en: 2.3 Access-Path Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.3 获取-平面评价

blocks.en: We refer to these alternative mechanisms as access paths . An access path is a transformation, interaction mechanism, or recovery procedure through which the same underlying targeted information may be accessed. Examples include paraphrases, translations, alternative scripts or modalities, encoded or obfuscated queries, and adversarial extraction procedures. Privacy-oriented evaluation should characterize whether conclusions about forgetting remain robust as these access paths change.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些替代机制称为通道。 访问途径是一种转变、互动机制或恢复程序,可以通过这一程序获取相同的基本目标信息。 例子包括释法、翻译、替代脚本或模式、编码或模糊的查询以及对抗性提取程序。 面向隐私的评价应说明,随着这些进入途径的改变,关于遗忘的结论是否依然有力。

blocks.en: Cross-lingual evaluation provides a particularly controlled example. Given semantically equivalent queries in multiple languages, unlearning can be performed in one language and evaluated in another while holding the targeted factual information approximately fixed. This allows us to test whether apparent forgetting generalizes beyond the linguistic representation in which unlearning was performed.
blocks.zh: 跨文化评价提供了一个特别受控制的例子。 由于多种语言的询问非常相似,不学习可以用一种语言进行,也可以用另一种语言进行评价,同时将目标事实信息保持大约固定。 这使得我们可以检验,显然忘记了是否超越了不学习的语言代表性。

blocks.en: 3 Cross-Lingual Unlearning as a Privacy Stress Test
blocks.zh: 3 跨语言 将学习作为隐私压力测试

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setting
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use cTOFU ( Lizzo and Heck, 2026 ) , a multilingual extension of TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , to study the linguistic access path directly. cTOFU provides parallel versions of TOFU’s synthetic factual associations in English, Chinese, Hindi, Italian, and Spanish, together with romanized Hindi and Chinese, while preserving the original forget/retain partitions. The use of synthetic facts does not itself model sensitive personal information, but provides a controlled setting in which the targeted information can be held fixed while its linguistic realization changes, isolating the effect of this one access path without requiring the use of real sensitive data.
blocks.zh: 我们使用cTOFU(Lizzo and Heck, 2026 ),即TOFU(Maini等, 2024 )的多语种扩展,直接研究语言获取路径. cTOFU以英文,中文,印地语,意大利语和西班牙语提供TOFU合成事实协会的平行版本,同时提供罗马化的印地语和汉语,同时保留了原始的忘却/保留分区. 合成事实的使用本身并不是模拟敏感的个人信息,而是提供了一个可控的设置,在目标信息在语言实现变化时可以被固定,隔开这个访问路径的效果而不需要使用真正的敏感数据.

blocks.en: We focus on one-to-one unlearning : unlearning is performed in one language and the resulting model is evaluated in another. All experiments use the 10% forget set and the TOFU forget-quality and normalized model-utility metrics described in Section 2 . Figure 1 presents Llama 3 with UNLEARN ( Lizzo and Heck, 2025 ) as a representative case from the broader cTOFU study (Appendix A.1 : baseline comparison; Appendix A.4 : model coverage).
blocks.zh: 我们侧重于一对一的不学习:不学习用一种语文进行,由此产生的模式用另一种语文进行评价。 所有实验都使用第2节所描述的10%的忘却装置和TOFU的忘却质量和常态模式通用度量衡. 图1将Llama 3与UNLEARN(Lizzo和Heck,2025年)作为更广泛的cTOFU研究(附录A.1:基线比较;附录A.4:模型覆盖范围)中的代表性案例。

blocks.en: 3.2 Forgetting Depends on the Linguistic Access Path
blocks.zh: 3.2 忽略取决于语言获取路径

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows that conclusions about forgetting depend strongly on the linguistic access path used for evaluation. After unlearning in English, the model satisfies the TOFU forgetting criterion when evaluated in English, Spanish, Italian, and romanized Hindi, but fails when the same targeted information is evaluated in native-script Hindi. The reverse direction is even more pronounced: after unlearning in Hindi, forgetting succeeds in Hindi but does not transfer consistently to the other evaluation languages. These differences occur alongside substantial variation in retained model utility (additional results are provided in Appendix A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 图1显示,关于遗忘的结论在很大程度上取决于用于评价的语言获取途径。 在未学习英语之后,该模式符合英语、西班牙语、意大利语和罗马化印地语评价时的TOFU遗忘标准,但在使用当地印地语评价相同目标信息时失败。 反方向更为明显:在不学习印地语后,忘记印地语成功,但不一贯地转移到其他评价语言。 这些差异与保留模式用途的巨大差异同时发生(附录A.5提供了额外结果)。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Cross-lingual access-path evaluation for Llama 3 using UNLEARN ( Lizzo and Heck, 2025 ) Each panel fixes the unlearning language, while points evaluate the same targeted facts through different linguistic access paths. The dashed line denotes the TOFU forgetting criterion ( p = 0.1 p=0.1 ); model utility is normalized relative to the base model. Apparent unlearning success varies with the language used for evaluation. See Appendix A.5 for additional results across model families.
blocks.zh: 图1:使用UNLEARN(利佐和赫克,2025年)对Llama 3进行跨文化接入路径评价 每个小组都修补未学习语言,而分数则通过不同的语言访问路径来评价相同的有针对性的事实. 虚线表示TOFU遗忘标准(p = 0.1 p = 0.1);模型效用相对于基准模型是正常化的. 明显的未学习成功与评价所使用的语言不同。 关于示范家庭的其他成果,见附录A.5。

blocks.en: The broader cTOFU experiments exhibit similar dependence on language and script across multilingual models. In particular, cross-lingual forgetting is asymmetric, and native-script Hindi and Chinese generally exhibit weaker forgetting and utility than their romanized counterparts (Table 4 ). Thus, even the narrowest kind of access-path variation, a meaning-preserving change in linguistic form, is already enough to change whether an unlearning operation appears successful.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的cTOFU实验显示,跨多语种模式对语言和文字的依赖程度类似。 特别是,不同语言的遗忘是不对称的,当地印地语和汉语的遗忘和效用一般比其罗马化的对应语要弱(表4)。 因此,即使是最狭义的准入-路径变异,语言形式上的一种保留意义的变化,也足以改变一项不学习操作是否似乎成功。

blocks.en: 3.3 Representational Basis of Access-Path Dependence
blocks.zh: 3.3 获取-半依赖性的代表性基础

blocks.en: The cTOFU representation analysis provides a mechanistic explanation, within this single access path, for why different linguistic access paths can produce different conclusions about forgetting. Task-specific weight subspaces exhibit substantial overlap across languages, consistent with factual knowledge being represented through a shared semantic component together with smaller language-specific residuals. Figure 2 provides intervention evidence for this decomposition: removing the shared multilingual subspace induces forgetting across languages, whereas removing a language-specific residual primarily affects the targeted language.
blocks.zh: cTOFU的表示分析在这个单一的取用路径中提供了一种机械解释,说明为什么不同的语言取用路径可以得出不同的关于遗忘的结论. 任务特定权重子空间在语言上存在大量重叠,这与事实知识通过一个共同的语义部分以及较小的语文特定剩余部分得到体现是一致的。 图2为这种分解提供了干预证据:去除共享的多语种子空间会诱发跨语言的遗忘,而去除一种特定语言的剩余部分主要会影响目标语言.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Representational basis of access-path-dependent forgetting. Removing the shared multilingual subspace induces forgetting across linguistic access paths, whereas removing a language-specific residual primarily affects the corresponding language.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 视路径而定的遗忘的代表性基础。 消除共享的多语种子空间会引发跨语言访问路径的遗忘,而去除语言特有的剩余部分主要会影响相应的语言.

blocks.en: These interventions indicate that cross-lingual differences are not solely artifacts of translated prompts: semantically equivalent facts can involve both shared and language-dependent representational structure (Appendix A.2 : translation validation; Appendix A.3 : method details). Consequently, success under one linguistic access path need not imply comparable forgetting under another.
blocks.zh: 这些发言表明,跨语言差异不仅仅是被翻译出音符的出处:语义上等同的事实既可以涉及共享性,也可以涉及语言依赖性的代表结构(附录A.2:翻译验证;附录A.3:方法细节). 因此,在一种语言通路下取得成功,不一定意味着在另一种语言下发生类似的遗忘。

blocks.en: 4 Toward Privacy-Oriented Unlearning Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 面向隐私的无学习评价

blocks.en: Cross-lingual querying is a controlled stress test of one access path, and it is already enough to show that a model can satisfy a fixed forgetting criterion while targeted information remains accessible through another access path. Linguistic transformations are only one family of access mechanisms; the same information may also be accessed through different formulations, modalities, or interactions. If forgetting is this fragile under one meaning-preserving transformation, a privacy-oriented standard cannot stop at one benchmark distribution, and future work should extend testing across the broader space of access paths.
blocks.zh: 跨语言查询是对一个访问路径的可控压力测试,已经足以表明一个模型可以满足固定的遗忘标准,而目标信息仍然可以通过另一个访问路径获取. 语言转变只是一种进入机制;同样的信息也可以通过不同的表达方式,模式或相互作用来获取. 如果忘记这一点在一个保留含义的转变下是脆弱的,那么一个面向隐私的标准就不能停留在一个基准分布上,今后的工作应该将测试扩展到更广泛的准入路径空间。

blocks.en: Future benchmarks should evaluate three increasingly demanding levels. (1) In-distribution forgetting tests the original forget examples and benchmark distribution; this is the current default. (2) Access-path generalization tests whether forgetting persists under meaning-preserving changes such as paraphrases, translations, alternative scripts, or modalities; our results already demonstrate failures here. (3) Adversarial recoverability asks whether targeted information can be recovered through deliberately constructed prompts, extraction, relearning, or other attacks; prior work shows such failures can emerge even when levels 1–2 are satisfied ( Patil et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , making this a natural next target.
blocks.zh: 今后的基准应评估三个要求越来越高的水平。 (1) 分配中忘记测试原始的遗忘实例和基准分布;这是当前的默认。 (2) Access-path通俗化测试是否在保留意义下的改动(如译文、译文、替代脚本或模式)中持续存在被遗忘;我们的结果已经表明在此存在失败。 (3)可逆可恢复性问到,是否可以通过刻意构建的提示,取出,再学习或其他攻击来取回目标信息;先前的研究表明,即使达到1至2级(Patil等,2025;Zhang等,2025),这种失败也可能出现,因此这自然成为下一个目标.

blocks.en: Future benchmarks should therefore distinguish forgetting on the target distribution from robustness across alternative access paths , with relevant paths depending on the privacy claim (paraphrases, languages, modalities, adversarial prompting, extraction attacks, or white-box recovery). Such evaluation cannot certify deletion, but can provide far stronger evidence that apparent forgetting reflects reduced accessibility rather than suppression under a particular benchmark distribution.
blocks.zh: 因此,未来的基准应当区分忘记目标分布和不同途径之间的稳健性,相关路径取决于隐私要求(短语、语言、模式、对抗性提示、取出攻击或白盒恢复)。 这种评价不能证明删除,但可以提供更强有力的证据,表明显然忘记了无障碍性,而不是在特定基准分配下加以压制。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Behavioral forgetting on a designated benchmark distribution does not establish that targeted information is inaccessible: our cross-lingual case study shows conclusions about unlearning success can change within a single, controlled access path. If forgetting is this fragile under one meaning-preserving transformation, a fixed benchmark distribution is not a reliable privacy standard. We recommend that benchmarks report which access paths a forgetting claim has been tested against, extend testing beyond language, and treat adversarial recoverability as a priority for future benchmark design.
blocks.zh: 行为忘记指定基准分配并不能确定目标信息无法获取:我们的跨语言案例研究显示,关于未学习成功的结论可以在单一的控制准入路径中改变。 如果在一种保留含义的转换中忘记这种脆弱,固定的基准分配就不是一个可靠的隐私标准。 我们建议,应报告哪些进入路径是被遗忘的索赔,将测试范围扩大到语言之外,并将对抗性可收回性作为未来基准设计的优先事项。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our main cross-lingual analysis focuses on a single representative unlearning method (UNLEARN); while Appendix A.1 shows this method outperforms several standard baselines in the monolingual setting, we do not claim that the specific magnitude of cross-lingual forgetting failure reported here generalizes to all unlearning algorithms. Second, our case study uses synthetic factual associations from TOFU and its multilingual extension cTOFU; these provide a controlled setting for isolating linguistic access-path effects, but do not establish that the same dynamics hold for real personal or sensitive information embedded during pretraining, which may be represented differently than fictional facts introduced during fine-tuning. Third, our evaluation spans five languages, including native-script and romanized representations of Hindi and Chinese; this is not intended as a claim of universal linguistic coverage, and forgetting behavior for typologically distant or lower-resource languages remains untested.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要跨语言分析侧重于一种具有代表性的不学习方法(UNLEARN);虽然附录A.1显示这种方法在单一语言环境中的绩效超过了若干标准基线,但我们并不声称,在此所报告的跨语言遗忘失败的具体程度概括到所有不学习算法。 第二,我们的案例研究采用了TOFU及其多语种扩展的cTOFU的合成事实关联;这些关联提供了隔离语言存取路径效应的可控环境,但并不确定在预训期间嵌入的真实的个人或敏感信息具有相同的动态,这种动态可能与微调时引入的虚构事实不同。 第三,我们的评价涵盖五种语言,包括印地语和汉语的当地文字和罗马化表述;这并非是要求普遍语言覆盖,而忽略了在类型学上遥远或资源较少的语言的行为,仍然没有经过测试。

blocks.en: Appendix A Supplementary Materials
blocks.zh: 附录A 材料

blocks.en: This appendix provides additional methodological detail and supporting results referenced in Sections 2 – 4 of the main text. These materials are drawn from the broader cross-lingual unlearning study (cTOFU) from which the results in Figure 1 and Figure 2 are drawn [ Lizzo and Heck, 2026 ] , and from the original UNLEARN method paper [ Lizzo and Heck, 2025 ] .
blocks.zh: 本附录提供了其他方法细节和主要案文第2至4节中提到的辅助结果。 这些材料取自更广泛的跨语言非学习研究(cTOFU),图1和图2中的结果取自[Lizzo and Heck, 2026],取自UNLEARN最初的方法文件[Lizzo and Heck, 2025].

blocks.en: A.1 Why UNLEARN: Comparison Against Baseline Unlearning Methods
blocks.zh: A.1 国家 为什么UNLEARN:与基线法的比较

blocks.en: Figure 1 and Figure 2 in the main text report results for UNLEARN [ Lizzo and Heck, 2025 ] as a representative unlearning method. This choice is motivated by its consistently stronger forget-quality/utility trade-off relative to standard baselines (DPO, Gradient Ascent, KL Minimization, Gradient Difference, NPO, and FLAT) in the monolingual (English-English) setting, prior to introducing any cross-lingual access-path variation. Table 1 reports this monolingual baseline comparison across three multilingual model families.
blocks.zh: 主文中的图1和图2为UNLEARN[Lizzo and Heck,2025]作为一种具有代表性的不学习方法的结果。 这种选择的动机是,在采用任何跨语言的存取路径变异之前,相对于标准基线(DPO、渐渐上升、KL最小化、渐渐差异、NPO和FLAT)而言,在单一语言(英语-英语)设定中,其忘却质量/效用的取舍始终更强。 表1报告三个多语种示范家庭的单一语言基线比较。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison of unlearning performance on the English-English TOFU benchmark [ Maini et al., 2024 ] for three models: Llama 3, Mixtral, and Aya 23. Among unlearning methods, the best value in ecah column is bolded and the second-best is underlined. ✓marks forget quality above α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 .
blocks.zh: 表1:英语-英语TOFU基准的未学习性能比较[Maini等,2024] 三种模型:Llama 3,Mixtral,和Aya 23. 在不学习的方法中,Ecah一栏中的最佳价值被大胆地标出并被下划线. α = 0.1\alpha = 0.1 的标记忘记质量。

blocks.en: Across all three model families, UNLEARN is the only method that satisfies the TOFU forgetting criterion ( p > 0.1 p>0.1 ) while maintaining normalized utility close to that of the base model. This motivates its use as the representative method for the cross-lingual access-path evaluation presented in the main text, rather than a method selected post hoc to support a particular narrative.
blocks.zh: 在所有三个模范家庭,UNLEARN是满足TOFU遗忘标准(p > 0.1 p>0.1),同时保持与基模接近的常态效用的唯一方法. 这促使将它用作主要文本中介绍的跨语言存取路径评价的代表性方法,而不是支持某一具体叙述的特设方法。

blocks.en: A.2 Translation Validation for cTOFU
blocks.zh: A.2 cTOFU 翻译验证

blocks.en: The cross-lingual access paths evaluated in Section 3 rely on the cTOFU dataset [ Lizzo and Heck, 2026 ] , a multilingual extension of TOFU [ Maini et al., 2024 ] spanning Spanish, Italian, Hindi (native script and romanized), and Chinese (native script and pinyin). To confirm that forgetting differences across languages reflect genuine cross-lingual access-path variation rather than translation artifacts, cTOFU’s translations were validated using both automatic and human evaluation. Table 2 reports COMET-Kiwi reference-free quality estimation scores and human pass rates (400 randomly sampled examples per language, evaluated by fluent bilingual reviewers for preservation of author identity, factual associations, answer correctness, and semantic consistency).
blocks.zh: 第3节评价的跨语言访问路径依赖于cTOFU数据集[Lizzo and Heck, 2026],这是TOFU[Maini等, 2024]的多语种扩展,涵盖西班牙语,意大利语,印地语(母语和罗马化)和汉语(母语和pinyin). 为了证实忘记不同语言之间的差别反映了真正的跨语言存取途径的变异,而不是翻译文物,cTOFU的翻译通过自动和人文评估得到验证. 表2报告COMET-Kiwi无参考质量估计分数和人类通过率(每种语言随机抽取400个例子,由流利的双语审查员评价,以保留作者身份、事实联系、回答正确性和语义一致性)。

blocks.en: Table 2: Translation validation results for cTOFU. COMET-Kiwi scores measure semantic consistency between English source text and translated outputs using a reference-free quality estimation model. Human validation pass rates report the percentage of manually inspected examples preserving factual consistency and author identity across translations. Human evaluation used 400 randomly sampled examples per language.
blocks.zh: 表2: cTOFU的翻译验证结果. Comet-Kiwi的分数用无参考质量估计模型测量出英语源文本与翻译输出之间的语义一致性. 人类验证合格率报告在翻译中保持事实一致性和作者身份的人工检查实例的百分比。 人类评价使用400个随机抽样的每种语言的例子。

blocks.en: All automatically scored languages exceed a COMET-Kiwi score of 0.85, and all languages exceed a 93% human validation pass rate, indicating that the semantic content of the targeted factual associations is preserved across translation and transliteration. This supports the interpretation in Section 3.3 that cross-lingual differences in forgetting reflect genuine representational structure rather than translation noise.
blocks.zh: 所有自动得分的语言都超过了COMET-Kiwi分数0.85分,所有语言都超过了93%的人类验证通过率,表明目标事实关联的语义内容在整个翻译和转写过程中都得到保存. 这支持第3.3节的解释,即相互语言差异的遗忘反映了真正的代表结构,而不是翻译噪音。

blocks.en: A.3 UNLEARN: Method Details
blocks.zh: A.3 联合国研究:方法细节

blocks.en: The representative unlearning method used throughout the cross-lingual evaluation, UNLEARN [ Lizzo and Heck, 2025 ] , consists of three stages: subspace identification, subspace discrimination, and task removal.
blocks.zh: 在整个跨语言评价过程中使用的代表性无学习方法UNLEARN [Lizzo and Heck, 2025]由三个阶段组成:子空间识别,子空间歧视和任务清除.

blocks.en: UNLEARN identifies the subspace of a targeted task (here, a language-specific or shared factual association) within the weight space of the LLM via sequential, layer-by-layer training. Starting from randomly initialized weights, each layer l l is trained in isolation while all other layers remain frozen, maximizing the conditional language modeling objective on the targeted task data. To accommodate the rank-deficient nature of the resulting task matrix, each layer is parameterized with a low-rank bottleneck architecture T i l = F ​ G T_{i}^{l}=FG with interior dimension k k . This layer-by-layer procedure yields a set of matrices T i l T_{i}^{l} representing the task-dependent subspace at each layer, with early layers capturing higher-level semantic structure and later layers capturing more task-specific detail.
blocks.zh: UNLEARN通过相继的,分层的训练,在LLM的权重空间内确定一项目标任务的子空间(这里是特定语言或共享的事实关联). 从随机初始化权重开始,每层l被隔离训练,而所有其他地层仍然被冻结,使目标任务数据上的有条件语言模型目标最大化. 为适应由此而来的任务矩阵的等级缺陷性质,每层都被参数化为低等级瓶颈架构 Ti I = F G T_{i}^{l}=FG 有内置维度 k k. 这种分层程序产生一组矩阵 T i l T_{i}^{l } 代表每个分层中依赖于任务的子空间,早期分层捕捉更高层次的语义结构,而后分层捕捉更多任务特定的细节.

blocks.en: Naively subtracting the identified task subspace can degrade performance on related tasks that occupy overlapping regions of weight space. UNLEARN addresses this using a variation of the Gram–Schmidt orthogonalization process, which removes only the information unique to the targeted task while preserving shared (mutual) information with related tasks. For a target task subspace T i T_{i} and one or more related task subspaces T o T_{o} , the discrimination step computes, for each singular vector, S ​ V k ​ ( T i ′ ) = S ​ V k ​ ( T i ) − ∑ j = 1 N S ​ V k ​ ( T i ) ⋅ S ​ V j ​ ( T o ) S ​ V j ​ ( T o ) ⋅ S ​ V j ​ ( T o ) ​ S ​ V j ​ ( T o ) , SV_{k}(T_{i}^{\prime})=SV_{k}(T_{i})-\sum_{j=1}^{N}\frac{SV_{k}(T_{i})\cdot SV_{j}(T_{o})}{SV_{j}(T_{o})\cdot SV_{j}(T_{o})}\,SV_{j}(T_{o}), yielding a modified task matrix T i ′ T_{i}^{\prime} that is orthogonal to the related-task subspace T o T_{o} . This step is central to the cross-lingual analysis in Section 3.3 : applying this discrimination procedure separately to the shared multilingual subspace and to each language-specific residual subspace enables the intervention ablations reported in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 自然地去掉所确定的任务子空间,可以降低占用重叠的重量空间的相关任务的表现. UNLEARN利用格莱克-施密特正交化过程的变异来解决这一问题,该过程只去除目标任务特有的信息,同时保留共享(相交)信息与相关任务. 对于一个目标任务子空间T i T_{i}和一个或多个相关任务子空间T o T_{o},区分步骤计算,每个单向量,S V k (T i ) = S Vk(Ti) − j = 1 N S V k (Ti)- S V j (T o)- S V j (T o)- S V j (T o)- S V j (T o)- S V j (T i)- Sum j (T i)- sum j= 1}^{- N}\-frac{ SV_{k} (T i)\ cdot] (T i)\cdot SV_{j} (T_{o}) SV_{j} (T_{o})\cdot SV_{j} (T_{o}) , SV_{j} (T_{o}), 生成一个修改的任务矩阵 T i i i_{i}^{\prime} , 与相关任务子空间 T o_{o 的正交. 这一步骤对于第3.3节中的跨语言分析至关重要:将这一歧视程序分别适用于共同的多语种子空间和每个特定语言的剩余子空间,从而能够进行图2所报道的干预。

blocks.en: The final step reconstitutes the modified task matrix T i ′ T_{i}^{\prime} via SVD and subtracts a (possibly smoothed) combination of T i ′ T_{i}^{\prime} and the original task matrix T i T_{i} from the model weights: W ′ = W − α ​ T i ′ − ( 1 − α ) ​ T i , W^{\prime}=W-\alpha T_{i}^{\prime}-(1-\alpha)T_{i}, where α ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in[0,1] trades off forgetting strength against preservation of related-task performance. In the interlingua intervention experiments (Section 3.3 ), this mechanism is applied twice: once with the shared multilingual subspace as the targeted component, and once with each language-specific residual subspace as the targeted component, isolating the causal contribution of each to cross-lingual forgetting behavior.
blocks.zh: 最后一步通过 SVD 重构修改后的任务矩阵 T i i i i i i i i i prime ,再从模型权重中减去 (可能平滑) T i i i i i prime 和 原始的任务矩阵 T i i i i : W' = W – α T i – ( 1 - α) T i , W^{\ prime----- alpha T_{i}^{\prime}- (1--\α) T_{i}, 在那里, α∈ [0, 1]\ alpha\in [0, 1] 权衡了忘记力量与维护相关任务性能的关系. 在语言间干预实验(第3.3节)中,这一机制被两次应用:一次以共享多语种子空间作为目标组成部分,一次以每种语言所特有的剩余子空间作为目标组成部分,隔离每种语言对跨语言遗忘行为的因果贡献.

blocks.en: A.4 Model Coverage
blocks.zh: A.4 示范覆盖范围

blocks.en: Table 3 lists the pretrained model checkpoints evaluated across the cTOFU experiments summarized in the main text, spanning multiple generations and degrees of multilingual pretraining coverage.
blocks.zh: 表3列出了在主文概述的cTOFU实验中评价的经过预先培训的示范检查站,涵盖多代人和多语种培训前覆盖程度。

blocks.en: Table 3: Pretrained language models used in our evaluation. Active parameters denote the number of parameters used during a forward pass. Total parameters denote the full parameter count of the model. All checkpoints are obtained from HuggingFace.
blocks.zh: 表3:我们评价中使用的预先培训的语言模式。 活性参数表示在前行时使用的参数数. 总参数表示模型的全部参数数. 所有检查站均取自HuggingFace。

blocks.en: Not all models were evaluated on every language; language coverage was restricted to languages represented during each model’s multilingual pretraining (e.g., Llama-family models were not evaluated on Chinese, and Mixtral was not evaluated on Hindi), so that differences in cross-lingual forgetting reflect the underlying unlearning procedure rather than confounds from unsupported language capability.
blocks.zh: 并非所有的模型都得到每种语言的评价;语言覆盖范围仅限于每个模型的多语种预训中所代表的语言(例如,Llama-family模型没有在中文上评价,而Mixtral没有在印地语上评价),因此交叉语言忘却的差别反映了基本的不学习程序,而不是与不支持的语言能力相混淆.

blocks.en: A.5 Additional Cross-Lingual Results
blocks.zh: A.5 额外的跨部门成果

blocks.en: Table 4 reports the full one-to-one cross-lingual unlearning results for Llama 3, Mixtral, and Aya 23. The results reinforce the access-path dependence observed in the main text. Forgetting often transfers among closely related linguistic representations, but can degrade substantially across languages and scripts, and the direction of transfer is asymmetric. These results demonstrate that the behavior shown for Llama 3 in Figure 1 is not unique to a single model family, although the specific pattern and magnitude of cross-lingual transfer vary across models.
blocks.zh: 表4报告Llama 3、Mixtral和Aya 23的一对一全面无语言学习结果。 其结果加强了正文中观察到的出入途径依赖性。 忘却在密切相关的语言表述之间的转移,但可以在语言和脚本之间大幅地降解,转移的方向是不对称的. 这些结果表明图1中为Llama 3所显示的行为并非单一模式家族所独有,尽管跨语言转移的具体模式和规模因模型而异.

blocks.en: Table 4: Full one-to-one cross-lingual unlearning results across Llama 3 , Mixtral , and Aya 23 . Rows indicate the evaluation language within each unlearning-language block. A ✓ \checkmark indicates satisfaction of the TOFU forgetting criterion ( p > 0.1 p>0.1 ).
